atomic_rollback.assertions: Turn, event, inference run and both job intents roll back together.

independent_jobs.assertions: Both accepted jobs remain independent; durable state and events are checked.

adk_independent_acceptance.assertions: Acceptance commits null binding without contacting ADK.

logical_identity.assertions: Concurrent independent transactions produce one unique logical job.

http_idempotency.assertions: HTTP replay returns the original accepted turn and executor.

pinned_transport.assertions: File storage survives restart; delayed NAK, progress, ACK and resource close work.

acceptance_restarts.assertions: Accepted profile job and inference effects survive publication and process restart.

publication_ack_window.assertions: Lost confirmation leaves durable intent; broker deduplicates replay and exposes coalesced generations.

reconstruction_ack_race.assertions: Old ACK confirms only its generation after full stream recreation.

diagnostic_duplicate.assertions: Durable job/product and ordered events precede settlement; duplicate invokes no model.

concurrent_claim.assertions: Concurrent claims execute once and running delivery remains recoverable.

replica_matrix.assertions: Two independent worker connections preserve state/attempts for stale/future/early/running deliveries and drain transport.

protected_writes.assertions: All protected durable product write families reject expired/replaced authority.

timeout.assertions: Handler timeout reaches durable dead state inside hard deadline and settles.

inflight_fence.assertions: Progress does not extend deadline; late provider writes fail.

early_retry.assertions: Retry eligibility commits before delayed NAK; early notification consumes no attempt.

preboundary_recovery.assertions: Competing/repeated recovery follows boundary and attempt policy.

profile_process_budget.assertions: Real process kill/restart repeats only within authoritative attempt budget.

interruption.assertions: Interruption repairs session and emits exactly one ordered terminal pair without replay.

recovery_rollback.assertions: Flushed failure rolls back; competing recoveries commit one product/event outcome.

deferred_crash.assertions: Session creation before binding survives process replacement with deterministic identity.

missing_binding.assertions: Bound missing sessions never get recreated.

ambiguous_profile.assertions: Pre/postcommit ambiguous loss preserves one run, claims and profile revision.

provider_budget.assertions: Provider calls equal bounded attempts; durable failure cannot duplicate effects.

classified_retry.assertions: Only classified preboundary retry commits eligibility before real NAK.

diagnostic_input.assertions: Trusted malformed/versioned definitions fail closed and repair only the valid authoritative turn identity.

profile_definition.assertions: Pinned versions and strict stored input fail before provider call.

workload_isolation.assertions: Profile consumer never fetches diagnostic messages.

delivery_resolution.assertions: Parameterized terminal/stale/future/mismatch/malformed and unknown-definition deliveries assert PostgreSQL and settlement.

immutable_terminal.assertions: Database constraints reject terminal revival and rewriting.

diagnostic_exhaustion.assertions: Dead job, restored session and exactly one ordered terminal event pair commit atomically.

preboundary_outcomes.assertions: Permanent failures/exhaustion settle only after durable product repair.

progress.assertions: Progress prevents premature redelivery while PostgreSQL deadline stays fixed.

ack_loss.assertions: Lost ACK leaves committed success; redelivery is an attempt-free no-op.

diagnostic_ack_loss.assertions: All diagnostic terminal states redeliver safely with exact product/event preservation.

maintenance_policy.assertions: No-progress repair cannot bypass eligibility, deadline, budget or boundary.

advisories.assertions: Real maximum-delivery and termination advisories are observable without database mutations.

observability_privacy.assertions: Independent inspection/transport observations and allowlisted telemetry; sentinels never escape.

reconstruction.assertions: Complete stream loss and overlapping reconstruction/maintenance restore only eligible work.

diagnostic_reconstruction.assertions: Rebuilt broker cannot replay terminal/reserved diagnostic effects.

cross_process_sse.assertions: Separate API and worker processes verify hinted wake-ups, missed hints, polling and event replay.

adk_resume.assertions: Actual subprocess resumes persisted ADK state/events; resources close and retained binding is protected.

worker_shutdown.assertions: Bounded graceful settlement or forced cancellation leaves durable running state and broker redelivery.

api_lifecycle.assertions: API lifespan owns asynchronous maintenance and closes resources without route logic.

multi_host.assertions: Two independent API maintenance hosts publish/reconcile without duplicate attempts.

cleanup_race.assertions: Row-lock recheck observes renewed retention after concurrent confirmation.

retention.assertions: Bounded competing cleanup never deletes nonterminal, pending or too-young rows.

retained_delivery.assertions: Publication generation changes reset retention; retained terminal notifications resolve and settle without effects.

rolling_versions.assertions: Compatible worker replicas precede new producers; both definitions remain through retained delivery and producer rollback.

items.obligation: atomic creation and rollback of product state, jobs, inputs, and publication generations, including both independently executable jobs for an eligible image turn, without calling the ADK session adapter;
HTTP idempotency and concurrent job recording cannot create duplicate logical jobs, with `(job_kind, deduplication_key)` enforcing the race-safe identity independently of the client key;
acknowledged publication survives the configured broker restart;
a publisher crash in the acknowledgement window cannot duplicate effects;
deterministic job-generation message IDs provide broker deduplication;
an older in-flight publication confirmation cannot confirm a newer desired generation, while unpublished intermediate generations coalesce safely;
completed jobs handle duplicate delivery as a no-op;
atomic claim-and-load prevents concurrent duplicate execution;
replaced execution tokens prevent stale protected writes;
a handler timeout and timeout grace finish by the hard execution deadline, progress acknowledgements do not extend it, and late protected writes are rejected;
early redelivery cannot bypass `eligible_at`;
pre-effect crashes recover within policy;

post-effect diagnostic crashes atomically become interrupted, restore the session to `awaiting_user`, and append exactly one `diagnostic_processing_error` and `turn.completed` pair without another ADK run;

a phase session is accepted with a null ADK ID, deterministic ADK session ensure-and-bind is idempotent across a crash between creation and binding, occurs before the effect boundary, and never recreates or replaces a confirmed missing session after binding;
an ambiguous profile-inference crash may repeat the model call but cannot duplicate claims or profile mutations, and all calls share one attempt budget;
delayed NAK implements only application-classified retries;
duplicate delivery does not consume an application attempt;
an unexpired running duplicate receives a delayed NAK until the execution deadline and remains available for deadline recovery;
diagnostic and profile-inference work publish independently and neither outcome controls the other's eligibility;

diagnostic execution preserves immutable accepted turn content and artifact references while reading mutable supporting context from current authoritative state, including same-turn inferred profile facts when already committed;
`diagnostic_turn.v1` accepts only a `turn_id` and resolves all accepted instruction data through the immutable authoritative turn;
`profile_inference.v1` pins the turn, inference schema, and extractor versions, rejects additional fields, and idempotently resolves one authoritative inference run;
profile backlog cannot consume diagnostic capacity;
lower stale generations become attempt-free acknowledged no-ops while impossible future generations and subject mismatches terminate without changing job state;

malformed or missing identities terminate without mutation, while a trusted job with an unknown kind, unsupported version, or invalid stored input becomes `dead` without consuming an application attempt;
a `dead` job cannot return to a nonterminal state, and any later job-kind-specific recovery creates a replacement without editing the original;
pre-boundary diagnostic exhaustion atomically marks the job `dead`, restores the session to `awaiting_user`, and appends exactly one `diagnostic_processing_error` and `turn.completed` pair;
long work sends progress acknowledgement in time;
acknowledgement failure after commit redelivers safely;

an eligible nonterminal job with no execution progress beyond the configured threshold advances publication intent without consuming an application attempt, bypassing `eligible_at`, or replaying unsafe post-effect work;
maximum-delivery and termination advisories reach metrics and alerts without directly mutating job or product state;
the explicit broker-reconstruction procedure cannot replay terminal or unsafe post-effect work;
worker events wake another API process and polling recovers missed hints;
graceful and forced shutdown produce safe outcomes;
publication and reconciliation modules pass their FastAPI-hosted lifecycle tests without depending on route logic;
cleanup cannot delete a nonterminal or publication-pending job, and a terminal job remains resolvable for longer than JetStream can deliver it;
a rolling kind or input-version migration cannot route new work to an incompatible worker, and old support is retained through its final possible redelivery; and
messages, headers, logs, and metrics contain no prohibited content.
